gancho: Hiʻiaka's road to Kauaʻi is guarded by moʻo, giant lizard spirits. She fights Panaʻewa in a forest of fog and freezing rain, bets her life against two moʻo who charge a toll at the Wailuku River, and leaves a moʻo's tail in the sea off Oʻahu as the island Mokoliʻi. Based on N. B. Emerson, Pele and Hiiaka (1915), W. D. Westervelt (1916) and Martha Beckwith (1940).
